title: Marginal-Nonuniform Multiclass Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.09543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the problem of multiclass classification within the framework of marginal-nonuniform learning, where the constants in the learning rate may depend on the unknown marginal distribution generating the unlabeled data, but not on the target concept. This notion naturally lies between classical PAC learning, where the constants are independent of both the marginal distribution and the target concept, and more recent universal learning, where the constants may depend on both. We give a complete characterization of the optimal marginal-nonuniform learning rates, establishing a fundamental trichotomy: exponential, linear, and arbitrarily slow rates. This characterization is witnessed by a new combinatorial dimension, termed the uncentered DS-eluder dimension. translated_title: 边缘非一致多分类学习
translated_abstract: 我们在边缘非一致学习框架下研究多分类问题，其中学习率中的常数可以依赖于生成无标签数据的未知边缘分布，但不能依赖于目标概念。这一概念自然地介于经典PAC学习（其中常数既不依赖于边缘分布也不依赖于目标概念）与较新的通用学习（其中常数可以同时依赖于两者）之间。我们给出了最优边缘非一致学习率的完整刻画，建立了一个基本的三分性：指数速率、线性速率和任意慢速率。这一刻画由一个新的组合维度——非中心化DS-eluder维度所见证。上界证明中的一个关键要素是一组新的分布耗尽引理，这些引理利用了该维度的序贯特性，可能具有独立的研究价值。
tldr: 该论文提出了介于经典PAC学习与通用学习之间的边缘非一致学习框架，并通过新提出的非中心化DS-eluder维度完整刻画了最优学习速率，建立了指数、线性与任意慢速率的三分性结论。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the marginal-nonuniform learning framework—lying between classical PAC learning and universal learning—and provides a complete characterization of optimal learning rates through a new uncentered DS-eluder dimension, establishing a trichotomy of exponential, linear, and arbitrarily slow rates.
